title: Stack Receipt
description: stack-receipt/v1 (ADR-087 D1). One envelope, two consumers: review-gate receipts (kind=review, minted by hooks/review-receipt-mint.sh from a genuine scripts/panel-review.sh run) and rollout receipts (kind=rollout, produced by scripts/rollout-verify.sh). A receipt failing this schema is treated as ABSENT, never as a pass. Only trustworthy where its directory (state/attest/**) is denyWrite-protected -- a same-user claim, never a cryptographic one (D2).

schema.description: Schema identifier and version tag. Always the literal string stack-receipt/v1.

kind.description: Closed set of receipt kinds sharing one envelope. kind=broker (D18): minted by the stack-broker daemon for every operation request, including refusals; subject.kind is operation and broker facts live under evidence.broker.

writer.description: Name+version of the minting script, e.g. review-receipt-mint.sh@1 or rollout-verify.sh@1.

as_of.description: UTC ISO-8601, set by the MINTER's own clock -- never taken from the payload.

max_age_s.description: A receipt older than this is NOT-CHECKED, never CLEAN (D11). Default 604800 (7 days).

subject.description: subject.kind is a CLOSED set: artifact | patch | config-dir. Exactly one subject kind's fields may be present -- a receipt carrying both content_sha and patch_sha is invalid.

evidence.description: review kind: review-evidence/v1 (D3a). rollout kind: D7's evidence block.

error.description: Sanitized per D19 (rcpt_sanitize) at write time. Never raw bytes on disk.
